expectedRealization.rationale: Data-center power-equipment demand can reprice suppliers before reported earnings, while order conversion, overseas shipment and AIDC revenue confirmation are primarily one-to-two-quarter mechanisms.

changeHypothesis.summary: Rapid data-center load growth is tightening power-capacity and grid economics in major US markets. A-share power-equipment suppliers with already-material AIDC revenue, expanding product breadth and credible overseas delivery can benefit more directly than generic grid-equipment peers.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: PJM's 2025 load forecast and July 2025 capacity auction both showed a structural demand/supply imbalance rather than a one-day event. Data-center demand grows faster than generation/grid capacity can be added, while supplier qualification and equipment lead times create multi-quarter order visibility.
disconfirmingEvidence: Capacity prices are not themselves revenue for Chinese equipment suppliers.
AIDC power-equipment expectations were already becoming a visible market narrative by September 2025.
金盘科技 traded at a materially higher forward PE than broad grid-equipment peers, so substantial growth was already priced.
Trade barriers, qualification, project timing and new capacity can prevent US scarcity from translating into Chinese supplier earnings.

causalChain.to: power capacity and grid investment urgency
causalChain.mechanism: PJM's load forecast attributes a large share of incremental demand to data centers, while capacity-auction clearing prices indicate tight supply.
causalChain.failureMode: Data-center projects are cancelled/delayed or generation/grid additions catch up faster than expected.

causalChain.mechanism: New and expanded data centers require transformers and power-conversion/distribution equipment; grid expansion also requires transmission/distribution equipment.
causalChain.failureMode: Equipment demand is met primarily by local incumbents, projects use different architectures, or qualification/trade barriers block Chinese suppliers.

causalChain.mechanism: By the cutoff, 金盘科技 already reported material data-center revenue, very high growth, broader data-center power-module products and overseas delivery plans.
causalChain.failureMode: AIDC orders are episodic, revenue growth decelerates sharply, overseas qualification/delivery is delayed, or pricing/margins weaken.

causalChain.mechanism: If the high-growth AIDC mix becomes a larger share of company revenue without severe margin dilution, earnings can grow faster than the frozen whole-company forecast.
causalChain.failureMode: High valuation already discounts the growth, other segments offset AIDC contribution, or incremental margins are weaker than expected.

losers: projects unable to secure grid connection or power equipment on acceptable economics
substitutes: on-site generation/storage reducing some grid dependence
falseThemeMatches: generic AI names with no power-equipment revenue
power-equipment companies with no verified data-center exposure

aShareCandidates.name: 金盘科技
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Pre-cutoff H1 research reported >5亿元 data-center revenue, about +461% YoY and ~16% of company revenue, alongside data-center power-module and SST development and overseas delivery plans.

earningsSensitivity.base: Sell-side already expected 2025 net profit around 7.36亿元 and about 36x forward PE, so ordinary AIDC growth was not hidden.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: AIDC revenue remains several times prior-year levels, overseas delivery contributes in H2, and power-module product breadth expands faster than the frozen whole-company earnings baseline.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: AIDC growth normalizes rapidly, overseas delivery slips, valuation compresses or non-AIDC segments dilute earnings acceleration.

matchedControls.name: 伊戈尔
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Same broad transformer/AIDC power-equipment opportunity, with data-center products and overseas expansion visible by the cutoff.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 金盘科技 had already converted AIDC into >5亿元 H1 revenue, ~461% YoY growth and ~16% revenue share, while 伊戈尔's data-center capacity/products were still ramping and H1 net profit was down about 41%.

matchedControls.name: 思源电气
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: High-quality A-share transmission/distribution equipment supplier with strong overseas growth, representing broad power/grid sector beta.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 思源电气 had stronger broad grid/overseas fundamentals and lower valuation, but the cutoff evidence tied less of its revenue directly to AIDC; the thesis specifically predicts that direct AIDC monetization should add incremental alpha beyond generic grid-equipment strength.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The AIDC narrative was already visible. Sell-side expected 金盘科技 2025 net profit around 7.36亿元 and ~36x PE; 思源电气 around 24.6x 2025E PE with strong broad grid growth; 伊戈尔 around 29.2x with H1 profit pressure but improving data-center exposure.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Direct AIDC monetization and product breadth at 金盘科技 should translate the structural power constraint into faster company-level earnings/repricing than a still-ramping AIDC near-miss and a generic grid-equipment sector proxy.
expectations.measurableGap: This is a cross-sectional gap, not a sector-discovery claim: the selected company should outperform the equal-weight matched-control basket at the pre-registered base horizon if direct AIDC exposure is truly the differentiated driver.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: 金盘科技's frozen forward PE was materially higher than controls, so valuation is a major hurdle rather than a supporting argument.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: partially_priced_and_high_bar: the AIDC theme was public and valuation elevated; promotion is justified only as a cross-sectional test that already-material AIDC monetization can outperform weaker/directness controls.
constraints: Exact post-cutoff prices are intentionally not fetched before lock.
The run is exploratory_contaminated because live search pages exposed post-cutoff snippets before lock.

bearCase: AIDC power demand may lift the whole power-equipment sector, but 金盘科技's high valuation may already price its direct exposure. A cheaper broad grid supplier or an initially weaker near-miss could outperform as sector beta broadens, making the selected-company thesis wrong even if the industry thesis is right.

invalidationConditions.indicator: AIDC/data-center revenue growth at 金盘科技 decelerates sharply or overseas delivery fails to ramp.
invalidationConditions.observationMethod: Post-lock company filings and point-in-time disclosures.
invalidationConditions.threshold: AIDC contribution fails to grow materially beyond the H1 run-rate or reported overseas/data-center expansion is delayed enough to break the one-to-two-quarter thesis.

invalidationConditions.indicator: Matched controls capture equal or stronger returns while the sector thesis remains intact.
invalidationConditions.observationMethod: Frozen equal-weight matched-control backtest at 60 trading days plus later fundamentals.
invalidationConditions.threshold: Selected stock's 60d matchedControlExcess <= 0; classify as sector_beta_only or thesis_right_stock_wrong unless later causal evidence clearly differs.

memoryStressTest.method: Identity-reduced A/B/C comparison of cutoff metrics before outcome reveal.
memoryStressTest.result: The company profile with already-material AIDC revenue and ~461% H1 growth ranked ahead of the still-ramping AIDC transformer profile and the broad-grid exporter on direct thesis exposure.
caveats: Live search pages exposed some post-cutoff snippets; run is exploratory_contaminated and cannot establish historical alpha.
